Aphelios.summary: The fight depends on his active weapons. Once his red and white guns are empty, he loses his dueling power and becomes easy to burst.

Ashe.summary: Every arrow slows you and keeps you out of range. She has no escapes, but walking up to farm is risky unless your support is a tank who can protect you.

Caitlyn.summary: She pokes you from long range whenever you go for minions. Let her push toward your tower so your support has room to engage and catch her.

Corki.summary: His escape dash is slow and straight, so your support can easily catch him for a burst.

Draven.summary: His early axe damage stops you from farming safely. You can aim W at where his axes will land, but never fight him alone early.

Ezreal.summary: He pokes from range and blinks away when you approach. Stand behind your minions to block his skillshots.

Jinx.summary: She has no escapes, making her easy for your support to catch. Burst her quickly, since a takedown gives her passive speed to flee.

Kalista.summary: Her hops make your skillshots hard to land. A slow or Exhaust from your support strips her mobility and makes her easy to kill.

KogMaw.summary: Fragile and immobile; any stun from your support usually kills him. Back off while his W is active, since it greatly extends his range.

Lucian.summary: Same short range as you but much higher early burst. He falls off later, so survive the early lane and you win.

MissFortune.summary: She dominates early because her Q bounces through your minions when you farm. When she channels her ult she is stationary, so use your ult to dash through and kill her.

Nilah.summary: Her shorter range lets you poke her. Step back while her W makes her immune to your autos.

Samira.summary: Her wind wall deletes your W, and her range is even shorter than yours, so attack her from a safe distance before she closes in.

Senna.summary: She is very squishy and cannot survive your burst when she farms. End before her souls give her huge range.

Sivir.summary: Her short range and predictable waveclear let you keep the wave near your tower. Bait her spell shield before using your main damage.

Smolder.summary: His early game is very weak, so bully him off minions. Close the game before his fireball upgrades take over fights.

Tristana.summary: Her bomb hits hard and she jumps away if you fight back. She pushes fast, so let the wave come to you and farm safely.

Twitch.summary: He ambushes from stealth with high attack speed. Use an Oracle Lens to reveal him before he surprises you.

Varus.summary: His long-range arrows pierce your wave and take big chunks. He is slow and fragile, so a support stun usually kills him.

Vayne.summary: Both of you are short-ranged scalers. Your burst is much faster early, giving you the advantage in short fights.

Xayah.summary: She roots you by recalling feathers. Use your ult to dash behind her and avoid the feather line to win the duel.

Yunara.summary: Her crits add magic damage and a stacked Q makes her autos splash heavily. Pressure her early before she stacks, since late game she outranges and melts you.

Zeri.summary: Her autos are blocked by minions, so stand behind your wave. She can slide over walls, so your support must stun her quickly.
